title: Main red: two S11 records lack review_by after S15 pack hygiene
body:
Outcome: main is green again: s-ts-erasable-syntax and s-ts-strict-optional (added by #1152) carry review_by like every advisory record, as test/brain/pack-hygiene.test.ts (added by #1153) requires.
Why: #1152 and #1153 were each green on their own base and merged minutes apart; main CI at a7b80aa failed pack-hygiene (2 records without review_by), turning every later PR red (#1154).
Proof: node --test test/brain/pack-hygiene.test.ts: pass on main.
